headline: Şengün’s triple-double as Durant passes 33,000
dek: Alperen Şengün had a triple-double, and Kevin Durant became the fifth player to reach 33,000 points.
three: His 15th career triple-double moved him past Hakeem Olajuwon for second on the Rockets’ list.
Rockets up 10 at the half, then closed on a 15–6 run
Şengün, Durant and Thompson combined for 61 of 116.
Won it from three and on the glass
Threes made 12–5; rebounds 51–38. Houston made 12 threes to Phoenix’s 5.
